QuestInfo.name: Asking After Dark Lord
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to check on #b#p411##k, the hidden leader of the city. Time to take a deep breath and go...\r\n#rOnly characters at Level 32 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I checked in on #p411#, the hidden leader of #m10003000#. Truth be told, he's someone who doesn't really need me checking in on him anyway.

0.0: "I wonder how #p411#, who leads this city from the shadows as an invisible hand, is doing. Actually, he's also my boss. Anyway, it would be great if you could check in on him for me.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: You again. If #p425# sent you, I'd appreciate it if you told her that I'm waiting for the report on the task I assigned last time. Along with the warning that she'd better brace herself if things go south.
1.1: If you thought she was just an ordinary city official, you're pretty naive. Just remember that the role of a city official is merely a front she uses to move around easily, and it's far from who she really is.
1.2: Anyway, make sure to tell #p425# that I'm waiting for "good news" regarding this matter. Now, you may leave.

level.0: Do you truly believe you have earned the right to address me with such a pathetic level?
